spans.s:
मृड् r. 6th cl. (मृडति) r. 9th cl. (मृड्णाति)
 1. To delight, to make
happy.
 2. To rejoice, to be happy or delighted. r. 9th cl. (Accord-
ing to some authorities,) To grind or pound.

मृड m. (-डः)
 1. A name of Ś

. The fire that completes an obla-
tion.
 f. [डा or -डा(दा)नी] DURGĀ, the wife of ŚIVA.
 E. मृड् to be
pleased or delighted, aff. क, fem. aff. ङीष्, with आनुक् augment.

मृडङ्कण m. (-णः) A child, a pupil.
 E. मृड् to be pleased, Unādi aff.
कङ्कण ।

मृडीक m. (-कः) A deer.
 E. मृड् to delight, Unādi aff. कीकन्.
